description: One-shot patent due-diligence: assemble the legal bundle and return a risk verdict (Low / Moderate / High) with an AI-written rationale — is this US patent in force, battle-tested (survived PTAB), heavily asserted (district-court litigation), and when does it expire? Costs 40 credits on a fresh fetch; 24h cache is free. Risk is framed for a party considering making/selling a product that might read on the patent. Not legal advice.
name: risk_profile

cached.description: True if served from the 24h cache (free).

verdict.description: riskLabel (Low/Moderate/High), rationale, and the derived signals (inForce, challengeCount, litigationCount, expiration, owner).
